summary: This is an 8-K filed by CNL Strategic Residential Credit, Inc. reporting a routine monthly determination of net asset value per share, a corresponding adjustment to offering prices for its private placement share classes (Class E, FA, A, T, I), and the declaration of a regular monthly distribution. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, delisting, activist campaign, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a standard periodic update for a continuously offered non-traded REIT and does not trigger any event-driven or risk-arbitrage analysis.
